note: The path-to-test-set map scripts/select_tests_for_change.py selects with. A changed test file selects itself; a changed path selects the tests that read it (reference_method, derived from the bytes of the tree being judged); a rule below selects its tests; a no_test_paths match that no test reads selects nothing; any other changed path is unmapped and selects the whole suite. Nothing here marks a test as bypassable: a test not selected is listed as not selected for this change, not run for that verdict, and never reported as passing.
reference_method: literal repository paths containing '/' and ROOT-joined paths in a Python file, plus this repository's Python modules it imports; closed over this repository's Python files
